description: This file defines the class TickLabels within the PdfSharp.Charting namespace. The class manages label formatting for chart axis tick labels, including properties for label format strings and font styling, along with cloning capabilities.

classes.name: TickLabels
classes.description: Represents the format and appearance of axis tick labels in a chart, supporting cloning and deep copy operations.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the TickLabels object.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of the object, including cloning the font for the label.
